key_insight: Random splits can reward recipe memorisation, while provenance-grouped evaluation reveals which models generalise to unseen perovskite solar-cell research.
engineering_relevance: Reliable device optimisation requires testing beyond familiar recipes and considering fabrication methods and device architecture alongside absorber chemistry.
method: Map institutional provenance in the Perovskite Database.
Apply progressively stricter splits separating duplicate devices, publications and institutions.
Benchmark 13 models and analyse feature importance.
evidence_signal: Nearly two-thirds of curated devices share an exact recipe with another; tree ensembles lead on random splits but lose their advantage to composition-aware neural models on unseen institutions and future discoveries.
watch_item: Provenance-grouped evaluation depends on accurate recipe, publication and institution metadata and does not replace prospective experimental validation.
paper_title: Provenance-grouped protocol for evaluating machine learning in perovskite photovoltaics
